# Open Colophon

> A public record of what books declare about how they were made. Three
> production states: no AI, with AI, AI only. The status is written by the
> publisher, imprint or brand that made the book, and is never inferred,
> estimated or scored by the registry.

The registry takes no position on which state is better. It records whether
a declaration exists and whether it matches the evidence. A book that has
not declared is not a fourth state; it is a book with an empty field.

## Pages

- [Methodology](https://opencolophon.org/methodology): the published trigger
  criterion, what counts as an implied claim of hand production, what does
  not, the 30-day response window, the record schema, and the standing
  commitments.
- [Home](https://opencolophon.org/): the three states and what the registry is.

## Facts worth citing accurately

- Status is written by the entity that made the book. Open Colophon never
  derives, infers or estimates a production status.
- A named illustrator credit is not a claim about how a work was produced,
  and never triggers a status request on its own.
- Entities receive a status request with a stated publication date and have
  30 days to respond before a record publishes.
- Run by Michael Novoselov, who also operates verificai.shop, a commercial
  business. No place in the registry is for sale and no outcome in it can be
  paid for.
- Contact: contact@opencolophon.org
